 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0004
 Thomas Anderson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
8-13-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition, and demands strict proof thereof
as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure. Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant generally denies the allegations
and requests that Plaintiff be required to prove the charges and allegations against Defendant by a preponderance of
the evidence.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that the law places on Plaintiff, Defendant asserts the
following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence proximately caused or contributed to the occurrence in question. Plaintiff failed to
keep a proper lookout, failed to yield the right of way within the parking facility, and failed to exercise ordinary care
under the circumstances. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be
reduced in proportion to Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and Plaintiff may be barred if that percentage exceeds
fifty percent.
Second, the injuries and damages claimed were caused, in whole or in part, by a pre-existing condition, a subsequent
event, or an unrelated incident for which Defendant bears no responsibility.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by failing to follow reasonable medical advice and by failing to pursue
reasonably available treatment, and any recovery must be redcued accordingly.
</page>

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
